description: A written report of a finished match, or a preview of one still to come, with the story and the sources it drew on. Available for selected competitions rather than every match; call get_match first if you are not sure the match has one. Translated into es, de, fr, it, pt, nl, ru, ar and tr; other languages fall back to English.

kind.description: auto (default): report if one exists, otherwise preview. report: only a finished-match report. preview: only a pre-match preview

language.description: Language for team, competition and country names, and for the football-mania.com links (en, es, de, fr, it, pt, pt-BR, nl, ar, ru, tr, id, …). Default: en

match_id.description: Match id from get_live_scores, get_day_fixtures or search

name: get_match_report

kind.description: report for a finished match, preview for one still to come

language.description: Language the text was returned in

sources.description: URLs the report drew on, when recorded

text.description: The report or preview, plain text
